E1202

Lock file out of date (M12.1)

What

Lock file out of date (M12.1)

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Run `jet fetch` to regenerate `.jet/lock` from `package.jet`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1202: tests/ui/inline_package_stale_lock/stderr.

Error [jet.StaleLockFile]: The lock file is out of date
 Why: `package.jet` changed since `.jet/lock` was last written
 Fix: Run `jet fetch` to update `.jet/lock`
